news.title: Augustana University Announces Fourth Annual Critical Inquiry & Citizenship Colloquium
news.summary_en: Augustana University’s fourth annual Critical Inquiry & Citizenship Colloquium will culminate this year with two speakers — Drs.Robert P. GeorgeandCornel West, distinguished scholars and leading voices in American public life.
